meta.name: design-sprint
meta.description: Run a structured 5-day process to prototype, test, and validate product ideas with real users. Use when the user mentions "design sprint", "validate before we build", "rapid prototype", "test with users", or "should we build this". Also trigger when a team is stuck in endless debate over a high-stakes product decision, or wants to de-risk a costly idea before investing in development. Covers mapping, sketching, deciding, prototyping, and testing across Monday-Friday. For ongoing experimentation and MVPs, see lean-startup. For customer job analysis, see jobs-to-be-done. For non-leading user interviews, see mom-test.

copy.tagline: 用5天流程快速验证产品创意
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队常因产品方向争论不休，想低成本验证想法。
copy.tagline_en: Validate product ideas in a 5-day structured process
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team often debates product direction and wants to de-risk ideas cheaply.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成一个为期5天的设计冲刺流程，包括绘制地图、构思方案、决策、制作原型和用户测试，最终产出可验证的产品想法。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计冲刺”、“快速原型”、“用户测试”等关键词，或团队在高风险决策上陷入无休止争论时触发。

say.text: 我们想验证一个新功能，帮我规划一个5天的设计冲刺。
say.note: Claude 会引导你从周一开始逐步执行。

say.text: 团队对产品方向有分歧，用设计冲刺帮我们决策。
say.note: Claude 会安排周三的投票环节来定方案。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through a structured 5-day design sprint process covering mapping, sketching, deciding, prototyping, and testing to validate product ideas with real users.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "design sprint", "rapid prototype", "test with users", or when a team is stuck in debate over a high-stakes decision.

say_en.text: We want to validate a new feature. Help me plan a 5-day design sprint.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you step by step from Monday.

say_en.text: The team is divided on product direction. Use a design sprint to decide.
say_en.note: Claude will set up Wednesday's vote to pick a solution.
